THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Caramel Shortbread Creami with Twix

CrumblCreamiCut Week 1, Flavor 2 — single-freeze protein Creami with brown butter + vanilla base, Lily's chips through Respin (not Mix-In), zero-cal salted caramel drizzle, and chopped Twix pieces for the shortbread crunch. 350 cal / 42g protein whole pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min active + 24 hr freeze + 5 min counter rest
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~350 cal | ~42g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Use Fairlife 2%, not fat-free. The small amount of fat = creamier texture. Ep. 1 W1F1 rule carries.

Ingredients

CREAMI BASE

  • 1 cup Fairlife 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 2 tbsp monk fruit / erythritol sweetener
  • 1 serving unflavored whey isolate (~28g protein — adjust by brand)
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum (level measure)
  • 1 pinch salt

FINISH (added after Respin)

  • Skinny Syrups Sugar Free Salted Caramel (drizzle to taste — 0 cal / 0 sugar)
  • ~75 cal Twix pieces (~15g / roughly 1/2 fun-size bar), chopped

FLAVOR ADD-INS

  • 1 tsp LorAnn Brown Butter Bakery Emulsion
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

MIX-IN (added after Regular Ice Cream cycle)

  • 7g Lily's milk-chocolate-style baking chips

You want a caramel-shortbread protein dessert with less technique commitment than the W1F1 marble. Single 24-hour freeze, one machine cycle + Respin, Twix does the shortbread heavy lifting. Ep. 2 of CrumblCreamiCut and the standard-base variation the rest of the series will remix.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND BASE. Combine Fairlife 2% milk + monk fruit + whey isolate + guar gum + salt in the Creami pint or a blending vessel. Immersion blender until completely smooth. Zero lumps.
  2. 2.ADD FLAVOR. Add 1 tsp LorAnn brown-butter emulsion + 1 tsp vanilla. Blend again just until evenly incorporated — don't overmix.
  3. 3.FREEZE (24 HR). Pour into a Creami pint without exceeding the max-fill line. Freeze upright on a level surface for a full 24 hours.
  4. 4.REST + SPIN. Pull pint from freezer, rest at ROOM TEMPERATURE for 5 minutes (no warm-water step for this one). Process on Regular Ice Cream, NOT Lite. If it comes out powdery, that's expected — the Respin fixes it.
  5. 5.ADD LILY'S + RESPIN. Make a narrow center well in the spun ice cream. Drop in 7g Lily's chips. Run RESPIN (not Mix-In) — this is the creator's preferred shortcut after the counter rest.
  6. 6.CARAMEL DRIZZLE. Scoop into a bowl. Drizzle Skinny Syrups Sugar Free Salted Caramel over the top to taste. Zero cal, zero sugar — go heavy without wrecking macros.
  7. 7.FINISH WITH TWIX. Chop ~15g Twix pieces (~75 cal, roughly 1/2 a fun-size bar). Sprinkle over the top AFTER caramel drizzle so the shortbread stays crunchy. Eat immediately.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Level 1/8 tsp guar gum. Heaped = gummy texture.
  • Freeze the pint upright and level for the full 24 hours. No shortcuts.

If something fails

Powdery after first spin: Expected — proceed with the planned Respin after adding the Lily's chips. The Respin is what finishes the texture.

Too soft after Respin: Room-temp rest was too long. Shorten to 3-4 minutes next time (5 min is the max for a well-frozen pint).

Too icy: Verify Fairlife 2% (not fat-free), measure guar gum accurately (level 1/8 tsp), and confirm the full 24-hour freeze happened on a level surface.

Gummy texture: Guar gum was heaped. Use a LEVEL 1/8 tsp. Also check whey isolate brand — some are grittier than others.

Chips collect near the bottom: Cut a NARROWER, DEEPER center well before Respin. Shallow additions sink.

Twix loses its crunch: You added it before Respin or too far ahead of eating. Add only after all machine cycles + immediately before serving.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store the frozen pint upright and level in the freezer for up to 1 week pre-spin. Once spun + drizzled + topped, eat immediately — protein Creami doesn't refreeze cleanly with mix-ins.

Reheat: N/A — serve immediately after Respin + finish. If leftovers must refreeze, level the surface first, skip the Twix, and reprocess only when the frozen top is flat.

Lasts: Frozen pint (pre-spin) keeps 1 week. Spun Creami with drizzle + Twix doesn't refreeze well — the caramel goes tacky and Twix loses its crunch. Batch multiple pints if you want a week of dessert; process them one at a time.

Adult plate | Kid plate

Adult plate

Adult

Full recipe as written — whole pint = 1 adult serving at 350 cal / 42g protein.

Kid plate

Kid

Same base works for kids as a smaller portion. Skip the caramel drizzle for younger kids (sugar alcohols in most zero-cal caramels can hit stomachs hard) — Twix pieces alone are plenty. Cut Twix small for under-4s per safety pattern from prior recipes.

  2. 2Level 1/8 tsp guar gum. Heaped = gummy texture.
  3. 3Freeze the pint upright and level for the full 24 hours. No shortcuts.

Brands I use

Fairlife
2% Ultra-Filtered Milk
Same base as W1F1 — high-protein milk with enough fat to support a creamier Creami texture. The 1 cup + 1 serving whey isolate combo is the standard base the whole CrumblCreamiCut series uses.
LorAnn
Brown Butter Bakery Emulsion
The shortcut that carries the brown-butter shortbread flavor cue in the base without adding calories. Emulsion (not extract) means the flavor holds through freezing.
Lily's
Milk Chocolate Style Baking Chips (~50 cal / 1g protein per 14 chips)
Adds small milk-chocolate pockets without wrecking the whole-pint macro target. Stevia-sweetened, no sugar spike. Same chip Ep. 1 W1F1 used.
Skinny Syrups
Sugar Free Salted Caramel Syrup (0 cal / 0 sugar / 0 carbs)
Zero-calorie drizzle carries the caramel flavor cue without touching the macro target. Naturally sweetened, keto-friendly. Best-selling flavor in the Skinny Mixes lineup.
Twix
Fun-size or regular bars (~75 cal / ~15g per portion)
The Crumbl Twix-cookie inspiration is right there in the ingredient. Twix supplies chocolate + caramel + shortbread in one add-in — 3 flavor cues from one 75-cal budget. Added AFTER Respin to keep the shortbread crunchy.
